public_rationale: The relevant literature documents earlier constructive improvements, and the search found no substantiated impossibility result. That supports Marcus's distinction between unsolvable and previously unsolved. FunSearch nevertheless produced a new improvement. If unsolvable is read loosely as a particular result not previously achieved, the assessment would change.
limitations: Support is limited to the ordinary distinction between impossibility and an open problem.
Prior improvements alone do not prove that every later target bound was attainable.
An absence claim cannot be verified exhaustively.
